authorship.purpose: frozen diagnostic validation, never production calibration or threshold tuning

execution_contract.unsupported_cases: emit UNEXECUTED with case id and missing capability; retain in total denominator
execution_contract.oracle_resolutions: never feed expected_resolution.query as production retrieval input; optional separately named oracle-control run is not candidate success
execution_contract.revision_replay: create each previous_revisions body in order, then update to body_md under same doc id before indexing; assert current anchors and retain historical revisions
execution_contract.conversation_context: pass raw query and supplied history through real application context resolution; source pins identify prior grounded material but do not change current Space authorization
execution_contract.absence: nonempty top-k list is not a pass; require empty selected evidence
execution_contract.conflict: all grade-3 spans from all competing sources are required
execution_contract.preservation: do not edit earlier fixtures, golds, thresholds or original run evidence

documents.title: Oriole instrument loan
documents.body_md:
# Oriole instrument loan

The Oriole Arts Trust lends a bass clarinet to Mira Chen for the touring exhibition. Mira must return the instrument by 16:30 on 14 November 2027. The hard case stays with the instrument. The courier's name has not been entered.

documents.title: Ceramic kiln cooldown card
documents.body_md:
# Cooldown card

After the firing cycle ends, leave the ceramic kiln shut for 63 minutes. Open the lid only when the display is below 70 degrees Celsius. The 63-minute wait does not override the temperature limit.

documents.title: Copperline platform trial
documents.body_md:
# Copperline platform trial

The portable ramp for the Copperline platform trial is stored in locker R-8. Two attendants carry it to the platform. The trial starts after the freight departure; this card does not specify a clock time.

documents.title: Salvage tag legend
documents.body_md:
# Salvage tags

A violet tag means the crate is awaiting inspection. A silver tag means the crate is cleared for reuse. Neither tag records the crate's owner.

documents.title: Rowan exhibit humidity
documents.body_md:
# Rowan exhibit

Keep the display-case humidity between 44 and 48 percent. The target is 46 percent. Record the value at opening and closing. This instruction gives no room-temperature target.

documents.title: Nocturne projector reset
documents.body_md:
# Nocturne projector

If the status light turns amber, wait twenty seconds and press Resume once. Do not perform a factory reset for an amber light. A factory reset is reserved for the separate handover procedure.

documents.title: São Bento plaque proof
documents.body_md:
# São Bento plaque

Élodie Costa approves the São Bento plaque's final accent marks. Deliver the printed proof to tray B-14, not to the engraving bench. The supplier is identified only as vendor SB; no postal address is recorded.

documents.title: Cobalt cabinet inventory

Workshop Space: the Cobalt cabinet holds six brass handles. Its access card is kept by Leena. No spare card is listed.

documents.body_md:

Archive Space: the Cobalt cabinet holds nine ceramic handles. Its access card is kept by Tomas. No spare card is listed.

documents.title: Alder cart repairs
documents.body_md:
# Alder cart repairs

The Alder cart needs two rubber wheels of 35 millimetres diameter. Keep the existing steel axle. The note does not specify a wheel supplier or a repair-completion date.

documents.title: Marlin shelter materials
documents.body_md:
# Marlin shelter materials

Use twelve cedar slats for the Marlin shelter roof. Each slat is 90 centimetres long. The drawing gives no total roof weight.

documents.title: Quartz prize purchase paperwork
documents.body_md:
# Quartz prize paperwork

Linden Guild issues purchase order PO-682 to Vale Workshops for twelve brass brackets. Vale Workshops sends invoice INV-517 to Linden Guild. Linden Guild pays Vale Workshops. The 840-credit budget is a spending cap, not the invoice total. No bank account or invoice due date is recorded here.

documents.title: Eider passage cleaning
documents.body_md:
# Eider passage cleaning

The Eider passage is closed to visitors on cleaning mornings, but staff may use its north door. Cleaning is not scheduled on Sundays. Staff must leave the south door latched.
